description: This file defines the BedrockApi class implementing the BaseLlmApi interface, providing methods to interact with AWS Bedrock runtime, including credential management, message conversion, streaming responses, reranking, and error handling.

classes.name: BedrockApi
classes.description: Implements interaction with AWS Bedrock, including credential handling, message conversion, streaming, reranking, and error management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes BedrockApi with configuration, validates credentials.

methods.name: getCreds
methods.description: Retrieves AWS credentials either from config or via provider chain.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a BedrockRuntimeClient with appropriate credentials.

methods.name: _oaiPartToBedrockPart
methods.description: Converts OpenAI chat content parts to Bedrock ContentBlock format.

methods.name: _convertMessages
methods.description: Converts OpenAI chat messages to Bedrock message format, handling roles and content parts.

methods.name: _convertBody
methods.description: Converts chat completion parameters into Bedrock ConverseStreamCommandInput.

methods.name: chatCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Performs non-streaming chat completion by accumulating streamed chunks.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams chat completion chunks from Bedrock API response.

methods.name: completionNonStream
methods.description: Throws error; not supported by Bedrock.

methods.name: completionStream
methods.description: Throws error; not supported by Bedrock.

methods.name: getInvokeModelResponseBody
methods.description: Invokes Bedrock model and returns parsed JSON response.

methods.name: rerank
methods.description: Performs reranking using Bedrock's invoke model API, handling AWS errors.
